text:
Woman's body, river of gold

where, arms sunk deep, we receive

a blue lightning flash, clusters

of light torn in a leafiness of gold.


Woman's body, or sea of gold,

where, loving with our hands, we do not know

whether the breasts are waves, whether the arms

are oars, whether they are only wings of gold...


Woman's body, fountain of weeping

where, after so much light, so much

subtle touch, Tantalus' pain remains.


The solitude of God sounds. We feel

the solitude of two. And a chain

that does not sound anchors souls and mud in God.

translation.title: Woman's Body
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the erotic-gold imagery as it turns toward divine solitude and the silent chain.
